options.name: backup
options.description: If set, create a backup of the crontab before it is modified. The location of the backup is returned in the RV(ignore:backup_file) variable by this module.

options.name: cron_file
options.description: If specified, uses this file instead of an individual user's crontab. The assumption is that this file is exclusively managed by the module, do not use if the file contains multiple entries, NEVER use for /etc/crontab. If this is a relative path, it is interpreted with respect to C(/etc/cron.d). Many Linux distros expect (and some require) the filename portion to consist solely of upper- and lower-case letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens. options.name: day
options.description: Day of the month the job should run (V(1-31), V(*), V(*/2), and so on).

options.name: disabled
options.description: If the job should be disabled (commented out) in the crontab. Only has effect if O(state=present).

options.name: env
options.description: If set, manages a crontab's environment variable. New variables are added on top of crontab. O(name) and O(value) parameters are the name and the value of environment variable.

options.name: hour
options.description: Hour when the job should run (V(0-23), V(*), V(*/2), and so on).

options.name: insertafter
options.description: Used with O(state=present) and O(env). If specified, the environment variable will be inserted after the declaration of specified environment variable.

options.name: insertbefore
options.description: Used with O(state=present) and O(env). If specified, the environment variable will be inserted before the declaration of specified environment variable.

options.name: job
options.description: The command to execute or, if O(env) is set, the value of environment variable. The command should not contain line breaks. Required if O(state=present).

options.name: minute
options.description: Minute when the job should run (V(0-59), V(*), V(*/2), and so on).

options.name: month
options.description: Month of the year the job should run (V(1-12), V(*), V(*/2), and so on).

options.name: name
options.description: Description of a crontab entry or, if O(env) is set, the name of environment variable. This parameter is always required as of ansible-core 2.12.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to ensure the job or environment variable is present or absent.

options.name: user
options.description: The specific user whose crontab should be modified. When unset, this parameter defaults to the current user.

options.name: weekday
options.description: Day of the week that the job should run (V(0-6) for Sunday-Saturday, V(*), and so on).
